text:
lucas: Quick sync — we need a compact plan for shipping audit event field changes that won't break customer integrations. thinking about version headers vs envelope fields.
anya: +1. Are we doing a top-level `audit_event_version` or `event.metadata.version`?
maria: prefer top-level header so proxies / collectors can route by version without parsing payload.
lucas: agree. header = `X-Audit-Event-Version` on incoming webhooks and `audit_event_version` in stored events for ease of debugging.
reza: what about removal of `actor_ip`? some customers rely on it. we might deprecate but not remove for 6 months.
anya: deprecate timeline sounds reasonable. We should also add `actor_location` as structured {country, region} for PII tradeoffs.
maria: for PII, add `actor_location_masked` boolean and document retention rules. security wants KMS-encrypted fields for anything sensitive.
lucas: KMS note: add `sensitive_fields_encrypted` array listing field names and an `encryption_version` field. Backwards compat: consumers that don't understand encryption should ignore and treat as opaque string.
reza: can we support content-negotiation? eg `Accept-Audit-Version: 2` so clients can ask for v1 or v2?
anya: that would be nice but more infra. maybe support `Prefer-Audit-Version` header first and deprecate later.
maria: rollout plan idea: 1) feature-flag producer side to emit v2 and v1 in parallel for a month, 2) expose a `version` query param on export endpoints, 3) start dropping fields only after >95% client opt-in.
lucas: operational constraints: have to update Dedicated/Private docs and include migration mapping table. create a canonical mapping `v1 -> v2` for all fields.
reza: sample schema diff in case useful:
```
- actor_ip: string
+ actor_ip: string (deprecated)
+ actor_location: {country: string, region: string} (new)
+ sensitive_fields_encrypted: ["actor_email", "session_token"]
+ audit_event_version: "2"
```
anya: good. also add `event_id` determinism note — we should switch to UUIDv7 to make ordering easier.
maria: monitoring: add a `schema_regressions` metric when unknown fields exceed 0.1% of events. alert on >1% unknown fields for 1h.
lucas: customer-facing validation: we should publish a small validator lib (python/node) and a Postman collection. devex-bot, can we prioritize a tiny npm package?
devex-bot: opened GH issue #1234 and assigned to @devex for initial prototype. ETA 2w. :rocket:
reza: migration comms: ops-team should send a targeted email to customers with PDAs and dedicated clusters 30d before removal. include sample code.
anya: doc checklist: API header docs, mapping table, retention + KMS section, troubleshooting guide for clients who see `encrypted` fields.
maria: RBAC impact: make sure auditors can still read decrypted fields; map `audit_read` role to KMS decrypt permission in Private installs.
lucas: action items: lucas -> draft mapping table by EOD Thu, anya -> write deprecation timeline, maria -> monitoring + KMS playbook, reza -> comms draft. next sync Thu 11am.
reza: sounds good. I'll start compiling customer usages to spot blockers.
anya: thanks everyone. will add meeting to calendar. :calendar:
